SELECT e.equipment_id, e.equipment_code, e.equipment_name, ac.alarm_count, cl.closed_count, cl.false_alarm_count, CAST(1.0 * cl.false_alarm_count / NULLIF(cl.closed_count, 0) AS DECIMAL(4,3)) AS false_alarm_rate, wo.done_count, wo.no_issue_count, CAST(1.0 * wo.no_issue_count / NULLIF(wo.done_count, 0) AS DECIMAL(4,3)) AS no_issue_rate, CAST(ak.avg_ack_minutes AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS avg_ack_minutes, CAST(wo.avg_action_minutes AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS avg_action_minutes, CAST(wo.downtime_minutes AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS downtime_minutes FROM equipment e
OUTER APPLY (SELECT COUNT(*) AS alarm_count FROM alarm a WHERE a.equipment_id = e.equipment_id AND a.created_at >= #{from} AND a.created_at < #{to}) ac
OUTER APPLY (SELECT COUNT(*) AS closed_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.close_reason = 'FALSE_ALARM' THEN 1 END) AS false_alarm_count FROM alarm a WHERE a.equipment_id = e.equipment_id AND a.closed_at >= #{from} AND a.closed_at < #{to}) cl
OUTER APPLY (SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF(SECOND, a.created_at, a.acked_at) / 60.0) AS avg_ack_minutes FROM alarm a WHERE a.equipment_id = e.equipment_id AND a.acked_at >= #{from} AND a.acked_at < #{to}) ak
OUTER APPLY (SELECT COUNT(*) AS done_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN w.result_code = 'NO_ISSUE' THEN 1 END) AS no_issue_count, AVG(DATEDIFF(SECOND, a.acked_at, w.completed_at) / 60.0) AS avg_action_minutes, ISNULL(SUM(DATEDIFF(SECOND, w.started_at, w.completed_at)), 0) / 60.0 AS downtime_minutes FROM work_order w JOIN alarm a ON a.alarm_id = w.alarm_id WHERE a.equipment_id = e.equipment_id AND w.status = 'DONE' AND w.completed_at >= #{from} AND w.completed_at < #{to}) wo ORDER BY e.equipment_id

SELECT d.stat_date, SUM(d.alarm) AS alarm_count, SUM(d.false_alarm) AS false_alarm_count, SUM(d.work_order) AS work_order_count, SUM(d.work_order_done) AS work_order_done_count FROM ( SELECT CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS stat_date, 1 AS alarm, 0 AS false_alarm, 0 AS work_order, 0 AS work_order_done FROM alarm WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} UNION ALL SELECT CAST(closed_at AS DATE), 0, 1, 0, 0 FROM alarm WHERE close_reason = 'FALSE_ALARM' AND closed_at >= #{from} AND closed_at < #{to} UNION ALL SELECT CAST(created_at AS DATE), 0, 0, 1, 0 FROM work_order WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} UNION ALL SELECT CAST(completed_at AS DATE), 0, 0, 0, 1 FROM work_order WHERE status = 'DONE' AND completed_at >= #{from} AND completed_at < #{to} ) d GROUP BY d.stat_date ORDER BY d.stat_date
